programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Tai Chi
programs.description: Embrace the body and mind through the practice of tai chi . Learn how to pair gentle movements that you will perform in a sequence with controlled breathing, to improve your flexibility, coordination, strength and mental concentration.

programs.name: Cooking
programs.description: Want to liven up the kitchen table? Come learn the basics of cooking and how to prepare delicious and nutritious recipes inspired by Canada’s Food Guide. From measuring and mixing ingredients to food safety, you will gain confidence in the kitchen.The City of Toronto and its staff cannot guarantee that the foods or supplies within its cooking programs are free of allergens. Notify staff at your location of any food allergies or dietary restrictions you may have.

programs.name: Crochet
programs.description: This hands on craft pairs yarn, thread and other materials with a hook to create beautiful textiles. Learn to interlock, loop and knot thread in a variety of patterns as you work towards completing a project.

programs.name: Learn To Weight Train - Small Group
programs.description: Strengthen your muscles with weight training. Perfect for beginners, you will learn fundamental techniques and a variety of exercises to help enhance your strength, mobility, flexibility and stamina safely. Class size is limited to four participants.

programs.name: Yoga
programs.description: Relax your body and mind with yoga.  Learn and practice yoga poses and postures to improve your balance, breathing, flexibility and strength.

programs.description: Relax your body and mind with yoga. Learn and practice yoga poses and postures to improve your balance, breathing, flexibility and strength.

programs.name: Yoga: Chair
programs.description: Gain all the benefits of yoga with the added support of a chair or your walker. Combining gentle stretches and traditional poses, you will improve your flexibility, strength, breathing and relaxation with every movement.

programs.name: Computers
programs.description: Designed for first-time users or those with some knowledge, this introduction to computers focuses on how to use a device with confidence. Learn basic computer skills like navigation as well as how to create an email, access the web, create documents and more.Equipment: Use of computers vary by location, please check ahead. You may bring a laptop.

programs.description: Let’s get creative in the kitchen and have some fun. A caregiver must actively participate in this activity.The City of Toronto and its staff cannot guarantee that the foods or supplies within its cooking programs are free of allergens. Notify staff at your location of any food allergies or dietary restrictions you may have.

programs.name: Dance: Latin
programs.description: Calling all Latin dance lovers, this is your chance to try the tango, rumba, cha-cha and mambo.  Learn basic steps, postures and holds through various exercises and engaging choreography. Dancers will be partnered in this class as needed.

programs.name: Functional Fit
programs.description: This conditioning workout is designed to help you build strength to support day-to-day activities. At your own pace, you will practice basic movements like pushing, pulling, bending and squatting to improve your overall functional fitness.

programs.name: Painting with Caregiver
programs.description: Create pictures with paint. Learn how to mix and choose colours and how to use tools like sponges, brushes, stamps and even your fingers to create different textures. A caregiver must actively participate in this activity.

programs.name: Painting: Acrylic
programs.description: Create pictures with acrylic paint. Learn how to mix and choose colours, how to use tools to create different textures and add layers of paint to create depth.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Tai Chi

programs.name: Tennis - Private
programs.description: This activity provides personalized instruction in tennis with a one-on-one ratio. Learn, practice and improve game basics like serving, rallying, forehand and backhand, while knowing all the game rules.

programs.name: Ultra Swim 5

programs.name: Ultra Swim 8

programs.name: Ultra Swim 9
programs.description: Dive into lessons to improve your swim skills. Develop non-contact rescues and stroke improvement. Learn stride jump. Work towards a continuous swim of 400 metres.Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 8.

programs.name: Volleyball
programs.description: Hit the court for non-stop volleyball. Whether you are a new or experienced player, want to play often or occasionally, drop-in volleyball offers something for everyone. Though not formally structured, guidelines are used to ensure participation is balanced. Supervision and capacity limits vary by location, please check ahead.It is free to reserve a spot in this activity, fees may apply at the time of check in. Please arrive 10 minutes before your scheduled start time to check in with staff and pay. If you do not arrive within 5 minutes of your start time, your spot will be given to someone in the walk-in line. A printed receipt or a mobile screenshot is required at check in.Participants are permitted to bring their own personal equipment.To cancel, visit your online account, speak with community centre staff, or contact Client Services at 416-396-7378 during regular business hours.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes
programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.    This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.
